variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, medium height, long slender variety suitable for cultivation across country under irrigated lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2017 for planting in Boro season having higher yield and zinc content than commonly grown variety BRRI dhan28. Moderately tolerant to leaf blight. Cold sensitive. Derived from a breeding cross involving IRRI line IR68144.
